result.summary: The page layout is generally intact. The notable visual oddities are a malformed decorative overlay in the promo banner and a loading spinner floating over the ramen restaurant image.

issues.description: The promo banner contains a large, blurry, semi-transparent circle/arc shape that appears to be an incorrectly rendered or oversized decorative graphic overlapping the right side of the banner.
issues.suggestion: Fix the banner decoration asset so it renders as intended, or remove/reposition the oversized shape so it does not look like a rendering artifact.

issues.description: A loading spinner is shown on top of the ramen card image, obscuring the food photo and appearing as a stray floating overlay.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator is styled as an intentional inline badge/overlay (e.g., bottom-left corner) or is removed once the image has loaded.
